versions.changelog:
- Documentation (SKILL.md) reformatted for clarity; no functional changes.
- No user-facing features, fixes, or breaking changes in this release.

**Skill now uses its own device-code authentication and token storage for Outlook contacts.**

- New standalone device-code login and token management under `~/.outlook-contacts/`.
- No longer shares tokens/config with outlook-calendar; requires separate setup.
- Added dedicated token management scripts: `setup-device-code.sh`, `token.sh`, and shared `_lib.sh`.
- Updated documentation for standalone operation and first-time registration steps.
- Skill files and scripts now consistently reference the private contacts token store.

Security hardening per SkillSpector findings: accurate scope disclosure (family-shared 5-scope consent stated in all docs), removed OPENCLAW_CLI confirmation bypass (explicit --yes flag is the only non-interactive path), runtime validation of authority/graph_base endpoints, chmod failures now fatal, contacts read-path guidance narrowed, todo write capability documented.
Add skill-card.md (hub disclosure card). No functional changes.
Initial release. Portable paths (no machine-specific dependencies), bring-your-own Azure app registration docs.
